Name: Bill Cipher Void Chickens
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
03/10/19 UPDATE! Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2920800]iKeychain[/url] we now have a Content Patcher version! To install the content patcher version please make sure you have smapi and content patcher installed and unzip the file to the Mods folder, run the game with smapi and you should be good to go!

This is a silly mod that replaces your void chickens with Bill Cipher (Gravity Falls) chickens. 

He sleeps with his eye open, because of course he does

To Install:
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your void chicken and baby void chicken files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
4. Done! Launch the game and get weird!
